toolsPreview.name: view_portfolio
toolsPreview.description: Opens the interactive portfolio, optionally at a specific section. The user can also navigate between sections using tabs inside the portfolio. To jump to a specific section (e.g. the user asks for contact info or work samples), call this again with the section argument — the newest card supersedes older ones. The card's visual appearance (theme, colors, layout) is set by the portfolio owner and cannot be changed via this tool.
